_note: Trigger-coverage eval suite for the five descriptions trimmed in PR #19. Positives are realistic user utterances derived from each skill's FULL pre-trim description, INCLUDING the parts that lived past the 1,535-char cut and were therefore invisible to the model. Negatives are utterances that must NOT pull this skill; most are the trigger surface of a sibling skill in the same plugin, which is what makes the separation number mean something. Run: python3 scripts/score_trigger_coverage.py --old-ref main
_baseline: BEFORE is scored against old_description[:1535] -- what the harness actually showed the model -- NOT the full authored text. Scoring against the full oversized source would compare the trim to text nobody ever read and make every honest trim look like a regression.
